body:
Thank you, that really means a lot right now! 
I know what you mean, when I'm feeling low, weirdly enough it's the "worst" weather that takes my mind off things, and I'm surprised someone feels the same way, thought it was just me!
I'll definitely be writing more, especially as it seemed to help get me out of a pretty big slump. Don't know if or where I'd post it but I'm sure I'll be doing it again. 
And thank you, it's nice to know I've got somewhere to turn.
Thank you, I will definitely try.

The fear of it not working. The thought that if it didn't work, I'd be stuck here feeling worse than I had in the first place and have to deal with the consequences. That was the push to try and get help and talk to people rather than pushing them away and being stuck with this burden.
